functionDescriptions: Receptor for interleukin-2. This beta subunit is involved in receptor mediated endocytosis and transduces the mitogenic signals of IL2. Probably in association with IL15RA, involved in the stimulation of neutrophil phagocytosis by IL15 (PubMed:15123770, PubMed:31040185). {ECO:0000269|PubMed:15123770, ECO:0000269|PubMed:31040184, ECO:0000269|PubMed:31040185}.
